def save():statePath.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')

 try:
  raw=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text();return raw[raw.rfind(')')+2:].split()[0]!='Z'
 except FileNotFoundError:return False

 meta=json.loads(Path('/tmp/sophp-d122-full-meta.json').read_text())
